Payloads of the `longbridge` command-line client (longbridge-terminal 0.30, Longbridge SDK 5.2),
written from the SDK's serialisers (`longbridge::trade::types`) and the client's `serve` and
`auth status` code, for a paper-trading account in Longbridge's AP data centre. `serve_*` files
are JSON-RPC `result` values; `auth_status_*` are `longbridge auth status --format json`.
